audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing in either layer connects Ground Slam's attack-speed reduction to Electrical Surge. Riot on W: 'Kennen passively deals extra damage and adds a Mark of the Storm to his target every few attacks.' Riot on Malphite E: 'reduces the Attack Speed of enemies for a short duration.'
audit.why: Kennen's stun is not a spell, it is a counter — three Marks of the Storm. One of the three reliably comes from Electrical Surge's passive, which pays out per attack. Cutting his attack speed directly slows the rate at which that third mark arrives, which is the single most valuable defensive effect Malphite owns in this lane and it is stated nowhere.
audit.corrected: Ground Slam's attack-speed cut delays Electrical Surge's on-hit marks, pushing the third-mark stun later.
sources: champ-data/_kits/kennen.json (W Electrical Surge, P Mark of the Storm)

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.foe[0] calls his poke 'Q Lightning bolt' and whys[0] calls it 'his Q bolt'. Kennen's Q is Thundering Shuriken.
audit.why: A fabricated ability name in the one line describing the thing that actually kills you. It also hides the number that makes the advice actionable: Thundering Shuriken reaches 950 against Seismic Shard's 625, so there is no range at which you can trade back.
audit.corrected: Thundering Shuriken, 950 range, 7s at rank 1 down to 4s.

audit.whatIsWrong: spikes[0] credits the levels 4-5 spike entirely to 'Granite Shield plus my armor', with no mechanism. The real spike is Ground Slam coming online against a mark-stacking champion.
audit.why: Armour is the wrong reason to feel safer against an all-AP kit. The reason 4-5 stops the bleeding is that Ground Slam's attack-speed cut throttles his mark generation, and Thunderclap's bonus armour feeds Ground Slam's own damage.
audit.corrected: Spike restated on the Ground Slam / Electrical Surge interaction.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Lightning Rush as matchup-defining but contains no numbers at all, and never mentions that Slicing Maelstrom is 120s flat against Unstoppable Force's 130s at rank 1.
audit.why: The ult trade is the fight this lane decides, and Kennen's ult comes back first at every rank of his. That is a concrete reason not to trade ults one-for-one, and it needs the two numbers side by side to land.
audit.corrected: Lightning Rush 10s at rank 1 to 6s, Thundering Shuriken 7s to 4s, Slicing Maelstrom 120s versus your 130s.

audit.why: Kennen holding levels 1-5 and the lane evening out in teamfights matches the 51.34% headline over 672 games and matches the content chart; no change proposed.

notes: Kennen's stun is a three-mark counter, not a cast, so the highest-value line in this lane is that Ground Slam throttles the Electrical Surge marks that supply it. The ult-cooldown asymmetry (his 120s flat vs your 130/115/100) is stated for the first time. Not asserted anywhere: whether Lightning Rush can be denied by Seismic Shard or Ground Slam's grounding — Riot calls it a morph that passes through units, not a dash, and the kit file has no dash flag on it, so I left grounding out rather than guess.
